title: Santa Weekends 2026
seo_title: Santa Weekends 2026 at Park Central Square, Springfield MO
description: Santa Weekends bring Santa and the SGF Holiday Express to Park Central Square in Downtown Springfield, where you can take a selfie with Santa in the Santa House under the Mayor's Tree. It runs Friday and Saturday nights from 5 to 8 p.m. on Nov. 27 and 28 and Dec. 4, 5, 11, 12, 18 and 19. The first night is November 27, 2026, at 201 Park Central W in Springfield, MO.
